answer: Gating new identities behind a time-locked deposit slashes sybil economics: each identity must lock tokens for a fixed maturity, so mass fake accounts are no longer free - every puppet costs locked capital plus waiting time. Without this, a lone attacker spins up a hollow army overnight; with it, a comet-like burst of fake activity burns real stake it may never retrieve, turning the network from a cheap haven for puppets into a place where reputation is bought, not borrowed.
